# VayloAI — AI Career Copilot

> VayloAI is an AI-powered career platform that helps job seekers create ATS-compliant resumes, test resume scores, optimize bullet points for job descriptions, practice STAR technical interviews, and navigate their tech careers.

## Core Products & Tools

- [Free ATS Resume Checker](https://www.vayloai.online/free-ats-resume-checker): Instant 100-point deterministic ATS score calculator, missing keyword extractor, and formatting validator.
- [AI Resume Builder](https://www.vayloai.online/ai-resume-builder): 100% ATS-compliant single-column resume builder with Google X-Y-Z bullet generation.
- [Resume Optimizer](https://www.vayloai.online/resume-optimizer): Step-by-step resume tailoring engine against specific job descriptions.
- [AI Voice Interview Preparation](https://www.vayloai.online/interview-preparation): Real-time AI voice mock interview coach with STAR framework evaluation, vocal filler word analysis, and curated FAANG question banks.
- [Role-Specific Resume Guides Hub](https://www.vayloai.online/resume): Complete directory of ATS optimization guides, keywords, and X-Y-Z formulas across 21 engineering roles, degrees, and countries.
- [Career & Technical Blog Hub](https://www.vayloai.online/blog): High-depth technical guides, system design blueprints, coding interview patterns, and salary negotiation guides.
- [Pricing & Plans](https://www.vayloai.online/pricing): Transparent pricing: Free (₹0), Pro (₹99/mo), Premium (₹299/mo), Career Pack (₹499 lifetime).

## Deep-Dive Interview & Technical Blueprints

- [Top 15 Full-Stack Interview Questions (2026)](https://www.vayloai.online/blog/top-15-fullstack-interview-questions-2026): STAR model answers for Web Vitals, database migrations without downtime, and distributed caching.
- [System Design Interview Questions & FAANG Blueprints](https://www.vayloai.online/blog/system-design-interview-questions-faang): Distributed rate limiters (Redis), real-time WebSockets/Kafka, and database sharding blueprints.
- [Top 30 Behavioral Interview Questions (Amazon & Google)](https://www.vayloai.online/blog/top-behavioral-interview-questions-star): STAR method scripts for handling conflict, production outages, technical pushback, and tight deadlines.
- [Advanced React & JavaScript Interview Questions](https://www.vayloai.online/blog/advanced-react-javascript-interview-questions): React Fiber reconciliation, useEffect vs useLayoutEffect, event loop mechanics, and Core Web Vitals optimization.
- [Backend & High-Concurrency Interview Questions](https://www.vayloai.online/blog/backend-high-concurrency-interview-questions): Connection pool starvation, PgBouncer multiplexing, optimistic vs pessimistic locking, and N+1 query resolutions.
- [15 Must-Know Coding Interview Patterns](https://www.vayloai.online/blog/top-dsa-interview-patterns-google-meta): Sliding Window, Two Pointers, Monotonic Stack, Fast & Slow Pointers, and Dynamic Programming.
- [Applied AI & LLM Engineer Interview Guide](https://www.vayloai.online/blog/machine-learning-llm-interview-questions): Precision RAG chunking, hybrid search, LoRA vs full fine-tuning, and vLLM inference throughput.
- [Data Analytics & SQL Mastery Queries](https://www.vayloai.online/blog/advanced-sql-analytics-interview-questions): DENSE_RANK(), rolling 7-day averages, retention cohort analysis, and SQL query tuning.
- [What is an ATS Resume?](https://www.vayloai.online/blog/what-is-an-ats-resume): How Greenhouse, Workday, and Lever parse documents and rules for 100% ATS compliance.
- [How to Check Your ATS Resume Score for Free](https://www.vayloai.online/blog/how-to-check-ats-score): Understanding ATS scoring rubrics, the 80%+ match rule, and free instant resume audits.
- [How to Make an ATS-Friendly Resume](https://www.vayloai.online/blog/how-to-make-ats-friendly-resume): Step-by-step formatting checklist, font choices, margins, semantic headers, and Google X-Y-Z bullet formulas.
- [How to Improve Your ATS Resume Score](https://www.vayloai.online/blog/how-to-improve-ats-score): Actionable strategies to raise resume match rates from 60% to 90%+ with targeted keyword placement.
- [ATS Resume Keywords Guide](https://www.vayloai.online/blog/ats-resume-keywords): Hard vs soft keywords, indexing mechanisms, and placement techniques that avoid spam filters.
- [The Ultimate ATS Resume Format Guide (2026)](https://www.vayloai.online/blog/ats-resume-format): Reverse-chronological vs hybrid formats, layout pitfalls, and ATS-compliant templates.
- [Why ATS Rejects Resumes](https://www.vayloai.online/blog/why-ats-rejects-resumes): Common parsing traps including multi-column tables, graphics, buried contact info, and missing hard skills.
- [Why 90% of Resumes Get Rejected in 6 Seconds](https://www.vayloai.online/blog/why-90-percent-resumes-rejected): Recruiter eye-tracking studies, the 6-second initial scan, and AI layout heatmaps.
- [Tech Salary Negotiation Guide (2026)](https://www.vayloai.online/blog/tech-salary-negotiation-guide-2026): P50/P90 salary percentiles, counter-offer script templates, and negotiation leverage for India & remote roles.
- [ATS-Proof Fresher Resume Guide](https://www.vayloai.online/blog/ats-proof-fresher-resume-guide): How CS students and new grads can showcase coursework, GitHub projects, and algorithmic ratings with zero commercial experience.
